description: Compact action-domain-operation profiles used only to rank registered AnythingLLM functions. These profiles do not alter tool execution.

rag-memory.action: retrieve relevant remembered knowledge and context
rag-memory.operation: search workspace memory for information needed to answer the request

document-summarizer.action: summarize or explain an existing document
document-summarizer.operation: produce a summary of document content

web-scraping.action: extract or scrape content from a specified web page
web-scraping.operation: fetch and parse a known URL

filesystem-read-text-file.action: read one existing local text file
filesystem-read-text-file.operation: return the contents of one file

filesystem-read-multiple-files.action: read several existing local text files
filesystem-read-multiple-files.operation: return the contents of multiple files

filesystem-write-text-file.action: write or overwrite text in a local file
filesystem-write-text-file.operation: save supplied text at a file path

filesystem-edit-file.action: edit specific text inside an existing local file

filesystem-list-directory.action: list files and folders in a directory

filesystem-move-file.action: move or rename a local file or directory

filesystem-copy-file.action: copy a local file or directory

filesystem-search-files.action: search for existing files by name or pattern

filesystem-get-file-info.action: inspect metadata for an existing file or directory
filesystem-get-file-info.operation: return size dates type and path information

create-pptx-presentation.action: create an actual PowerPoint presentation file as the requested output artifact
create-pptx-presentation.operation: author and save a PPTX presentation
create-pptx-presentation.excludes: a picture or illustration that merely depicts slides or a presentation

create-text-file.action: create an actual plain text file as the requested output artifact
create-text-file.operation: author and save a TXT file
create-text-file.excludes: a picture or illustration that merely depicts a text file

create-pdf-file.action: create an actual PDF document file as the requested output artifact
create-pdf-file.operation: author and save a PDF file
create-pdf-file.excludes: an image or illustration that merely depicts a PDF document

create-excel-file.action: create an actual Excel spreadsheet file as the requested output artifact
create-excel-file.operation: author and save an XLSX workbook
create-excel-file.excludes: an image or illustration that merely depicts a spreadsheet

create-docx-file.action: create an actual Word document file as the requested output artifact
create-docx-file.operation: author and save a DOCX file
create-docx-file.excludes: an image or illustration that merely depicts a document

create-chart.action: create a data chart or graph from supplied values
create-chart.operation: render a chart from structured data

web-browsing.action: search or browse the public web for information
web-browsing.operation: run web searches and inspect results

sql-list-tables.action: list tables in a SQL database

sql-query.action: query or modify data with SQL

create-scheduled-job.action: schedule a task to run later or repeatedly

gmail-get-inbox.action: list or read recent inbox messages

gmail-create-draft.action: compose a new email draft without sending it

gmail-create-draft-reply.action: compose a draft reply without sending it
gmail-create-draft-reply.operation: create a reply draft in a thread

gmail-send-email.action: send a new email message now
gmail-send-email.operation: compose and send mail to recipients

gmail-reply-to-thread.action: send a reply to an existing email conversation

gmail-mark-read.action: mark an email message as read
gmail-mark-read.operation: change message read status to read

gmail-mark-unread.action: mark an email message as unread
gmail-mark-unread.operation: change message read status to unread

gmail-move-to-archive.operation: move mail out of inbox into archive

gmail-move-to-inbox.action: move email messages into the inbox

gmail-get-mailbox-stats.action: inspect mailbox counts and storage statistics

aag-chess-puzzle.action: create or analyze an actual chess puzzle position exercise or solution
aag-chess-puzzle.operation: generate puzzle, inspect FEN, find best move, give hint, or reveal solution
aag-chess-puzzle.excludes: creating a visual image whose scene merely contains chess pieces, a chess board, or a chess puzzle

aag-context-memory-v1.action: store retrieve list or forget governed AAG context memory
aag-context-memory-v1.excludes: ordinary content creation, file operations, image generation, or host diagnosis

aag-governed-orchestration-v1.action: diagnose troubleshoot inspect or maintain the Ubuntu host through governed orchestration
aag-governed-orchestration-v1.operation: coordinate approved system investigation or maintenance work
aag-governed-orchestration-v1.excludes: ordinary content creation or an image that merely depicts Ubuntu, a terminal, laptop, or computer

aag-image-batch.action: generate multiple distinct visual images pictures illustrations drawings renders artworks or paintings in one request
aag-image-batch.operation: create an exact batch of two through ten images
aag-image-batch.excludes: a request for one image, an actual document file, chess reasoning, or Ubuntu diagnosis

aag-image-job.action: inspect resume or cancel an existing AAG image job
aag-image-job.operation: get status, resume, or cancel by job identifier

aag-image-task.action: generate create edit transform or upscale one visual image picture illustration drawing render artwork painting or cartoon
aag-image-task.operation: create exactly one new image or modify one source image
aag-image-task.excludes: creating an actual PDF Excel PowerPoint or text file, chess-position reasoning, or Ubuntu diagnosis; subject nouns inside the requested image are scene content

aag-maintenance-intelligence-v1.action: plan governed Ubuntu host maintenance from observed system state
aag-maintenance-intelligence-v1.excludes: ordinary content creation or images depicting computers

aag-ubuntu-live-audit.action: inspect current live Ubuntu system state and diagnose host resource problems
aag-ubuntu-live-audit.operation: audit CPU memory disk processes services logs or devices
aliases: חקור עומס מעבד זיכרון או דיסק
aag-ubuntu-live-audit.excludes: ordinary content creation or an image that merely depicts Ubuntu, a terminal, laptop, or computer
